Your role will be an exciting blend of prospecting new opportunities—through personal research, networking at industry events, and collaborating with internal and external partners—and crafting bespoke solutions that leverage SaskTel’s cutting-edge products and services. Empowered to drive strategic revenue growth and customer satisfaction, you’ll nurture relationships with business leaders, present innovative proposals, and guide clients from initial engagement through to successful implementation. JOB SUMMARY
Responsible to utilize SaskTel sales methodologies to proactively identify, research, and contact existing or potential new customers to gain an understanding of their business needs and initiatives. This includes the identification of potential opportunities from individual research and prospecting, attendance at company/industry events or referrals from other SaskTel sales channels. Develops customer relationships by conducting needs analysis, creating solutions, proposals, and presentations to secure sales opportunities. Partners closely with other internal sales roles and Account Executives/Strategic Accounts Managers, internal partner organizations including marketing, finance and operations personnel, for proposals and delivery and also external/third party resources. Establishes and meets personal, strategic and/or customer-based revenue results for SaskTel business products and services.
TYPICAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
(Not all inclusive or applicable to all assignments)
1. Accountable for maintaining and growing SaskTel ICT and/or digital media revenues, customer base and market share.
2. Seek out, qualify and act on market/customer ICT and/or digital media opportunities. Actively work to understand customer business requirements, motivators and close sales.
3. Analyze customer needs and deliver ICT and/or digital media solutions that solve identified business problems and quantify the expected return on investment.
4. Develop and maintain a strong working relationship with key decision makers, owners, department heads or communication contacts to ensure acceptance of solution, successful sales negotiations and long-term customer relations.
5. Responsible for generating market awareness of SaskTel’s ICT and/or digital media product capabilities through such activities as customer events, customer information sessions, etc.
6. Recommend solutions, present proposals and deliver sales presentations.
7. Work with customer post sale to validate the value of SaskTel solutions.
8. Lead and/or team with Business Sales account teams and assign work to pro-actively protect network revenues, maintain working relationships and ensure strategic and/or individual sales targets are met.
9. Develop and evolve customer account plans, ensuring they are in sync with sales and industry plans. Assist in the preparation, evolution and delivery of Business Sales plans and objectives.
10.Obtain customer commitment; negotiate conditions of sale and present documentation for authorization.
11.Ensure coordination of implementation is successful and follow up to ensure overall customer satisfaction.
12.Proactively research emerging technologies and competitive threats.
QUALIFICATIONS
1. Degree in Administration/Commerce/ /Computer Science/ Engineering with a thorough knowledge of Sales techniques typically gained with 2 years of experience in a sales/marketing/technical role OR Diploma in
Administration/ Electrical Engineering/ Electronics Engineering/Computer Science Diploma in Information Systems /Computer Technology with a thorough knowledge of Sales techniques typically gained with 3 years of
experience in a sales/marketing/technical role OR University Certificate in Business Administration with a thorough knowledge of Sales techniques typically gained with 5 years of experience in a
sales/marketing/technical role OR Level 30 English with a thorough knowledge of Sales techniques typically gained with 6 years of experience in a sales/marketing/technical role.
2. Thorough knowledge of one or more of the following:
a) IP Networks
b) Convergence & Hosted Applications
c) Data centre sales, applications, integration
d) IP and Cloud based services
e) Digital media services, billboards, and print advertising
3.  Thorough knowledge of business fundamentals e.g. Finance, Marketing, Planning, Purchasing and Communications.
4.  Working knowledge of telecommunications, ICT, or media services industry e.g. regulation, emerging technologies and competition.
5.  Thorough knowledge of voice, data, information technologies OR creating content and building campaigns AND associated trends/issues with the ability to apply and develop business solutions.
6.  Demonstrated ability to interpret and effectively communicate technological concepts to clients at various organizational levels using both written and verbal methods.
7.  Successfully demonstrates sales ability in face to face sales environment.
8.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to influence and persuade others.
9.  Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver sales presentations.
10. Demonstrated ability to uncover customer business needs and business drivers
11. Excellent ability to manage multiple tasks and to plan and organize in a self directed environment.
12. Excellent analytical, problem solving, and decision-making skills.
13. Valid Driver’s License.

Lead the delivery of complex commercial construction projects with significant organizational impact.
Manage budgets, schedules, and risk mitigation strategies to ensure successful outcomes.
Provide strategic oversight and reporting to the program manager.
Ensure quality, safety, and compliance standards are met at every stage.
If you have a proven track record in delivering major construction projects, strong leadership capabilities, and a passion for driving excellence—we want to hear from you!

Accountable for the successful delivery and execution of large-scale capital construction and renovation projects from detailed design through occupancy and project closeout. Responsible for owner-side management of the physical construction of assigned projects, ensuring scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety, and operational requirements are achieved.
Provides oversight and direction to design consultants, construction managers, contractors, and specialty consultants throughout all phases of project delivery. Acts as the primary owner representative during design development, procurement, construction, commissioning, and turnover, ensuring all project activities align with approved program objectives, corporate standards, regulatory requirements, and operational needs.
Works closely with the Program Manager to manage project-level risks, issues, stakeholder expectations, and change requests while maintaining continuity of business operations throughout construction activities.

1. Project Planning & Development
• Leads project planning activities including scope definition, budget development, scheduling, risk identification, procurement planning, phasing strategies, occupancy coordination, and project execution planning.
• Coordinates design development activities to ensure project requirements, operational needs, technical standards, and stakeholder expectations are incorporated into project documents.
• Ensures construction planning considers business continuity, occupant impacts, safety requirements, and operational constraints.
2. Design Consultant Management
• Directs and manages architectural, engineering, and specialty design consultants throughout project development and delivery.
• Reviews and coordinates design submissions to ensure compliance with project objectives, technical standards, budget constraints, and schedule requirements.
• Facilitates design reviews and constructability reviews with stakeholders and subject matter experts.
• Manages consultant contracts, deliverables, performance, and compliance with contractual obligations.
3. Construction Manager & Contractor Oversight
• Acts as the primary owner representative for construction activities.
• Provides oversight of the Construction Manager and contractors to ensure project objectives are achieved.
• Reviews and monitors construction plans, schedules, resource plans, procurement activities, and site performance.
• Coordinates resolution of construction issues and field conditions.
• Ensures compliance with contract requirements, safety regulations, quality standards, and approved project documentation.
4. Construction Execution & Coordination
• Oversees construction activities to ensure work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with approved plans and specifications.
• Coordinates demolition, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, telecommunications, security, and specialty system work.
• Ensures effective integration and sequencing of multiple trades and work packages.
• Facilitates coordination between contractors, occupants, operational groups, and technical stakeholders.
5. Contract Administration
• Administers construction and consultant contracts in accordance with corporate policies and approved procurement strategies.
• Reviews and recommends approvals for change orders, progress claims, contingency usage, and contract amendments.
• Maintains appropriate records and documentation to support contractual requirements and decision-making.
6. Financial Management
• Accountable for project budgets, forecasts, cash flow management, contingency control, and financial reporting.
• Monitors project costs and proactively identifies variances, risks, and mitigation opportunities.
• Ensures expenditures align with approved project authority and funding allocations.
7. Schedule Management
• Develops and maintains project schedules and milestone tracking.
• Monitors progress against approved schedules and implements recovery strategies when required.
• Coordinates critical project activities to minimize impacts to cost, quality, and operational requirements.
8. Risk & Change Management
• Identifies, evaluates, and manages project risks throughout the project lifecycle.
• Implements mitigation plans and escalates significant risks as appropriate.
• Administers project change management processes for scope, schedule, budget, and design changes.
• Assesses impacts and develops recommendations to support informed decision-making.
9. Quality Assurance & Commissioning
• Ensures quality management processes are implemented throughout design and construction.
• Oversees inspections, testing, commissioning, deficiency management, and project closeout activities.
• Verifies systems and facilities perform as intended and meet operational requirements.
10. Health, Safety & Regulatory Compliance
• Promotes and supports a strong safety culture throughout all project activities.
• Ensures compliance with applicable legislation, building codes, regulatory requirements, and corporate safety standards.
• Monitors contractor safety performance and addresses concerns promptly.
11.Stakeholder Management & Communication
• Maintains strong relationships with project stakeholders, business units, technical authorities, consultants, contractors, and regulatory agencies.
• Provides regular project reporting on status, risks, budget, schedule, and key decisions.
• Facilitates project meetings and supports stakeholder engagement activities.
• Communicates impacts, risks, and construction activities effectively to affected groups.
12.Project Closeout & Occupancy
• Coordinates commissioning, training, occupancy planning, turnover documentation, warranties, and post-occupancy support.
• Ensures project documentation is complete and deficiencies are resolved prior to project closure.
• Leads lessons learned reviews and supports continuous improvement initiatives.

Are you passionate about sales and looking to make a significant impact in the business world? SaskTel is seeking dynamic individuals to join our talent pool for future Service Representative (Business Sales - Incented Sales Rep) roles in our Small Medium Business Call Center in Regina. By submitting your application, you'll be considered for upcoming positions that align with this exciting job title.
What You’ll Do:
Be the Face of Our Business Brand:
You will engage directly with our business customers, representing SaskTel in various interactions. Your role will be essential in understanding and aligning with customers' business priorities, ensuring that our solutions add real value.
Leverage Proven Sales Methodologies:
Using your strong working knowledge of persuasive sales techniques, you'll promote SaskTel’s innovative business products and services in a dynamic and complex environment.
Deliver Exceptional Customer Service:
Whether behind the scenes or on-site, you’ll manage internal processes to not just meet, but exceed customer expectations. Your proactive approach will ensure that our clients’ needs are fully understood and addressed.
Drive Business Growth:
Your ability to understand business challenges and provide tailored solutions will play a key role in driving revenue growth and enhancing customer satisfaction.
What You Bring:
Sales Experience:
A proven track record in a sales role where you’ve demonstrated your ability to use persuasive techniques effectively.
Customer Focus:
A passion for delivering value to customers and the ability to understand and align with their business goals.
Dynamic and Adaptable:
You thrive in fast-paced environments and can navigate complex situations with ease.
Process Management:
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in managing processes and customer interactions.
Position Qualifications:
Working knowledge and ability to demonstrate techniques needed to persuasively promote the sale of complex Business products and/or services, typically gained from 2 years in a Sales role.
Working knowledge of SaskTel products and services.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to handle business customer contacts with tact, diplomacy and courtesy at all times, particularly when handling complaints and resolving disputes.
Good analytical, problem solving and decision-making skills.
General knowledge of SaskTel Business Sales products and services (wireline and wireless).
Working knowledge of personal computers and various software applications.
Good multi-tasking skills.
Successful completion of prescribed training courses.
Keyboarding skills 20 wpm.
Hours of Work:
This is classified as a casual - part time position which means that SaskTel cannot guarantee a set number of hours per week.  Hours are scheduled according to business needs. The hours of operation are Monday to Friday (8:00am – 5:00pm).
Our Service Representative currently average approximately 30-35 hours per week but this can vary and is based on business needs.
This is a unionized position, and you will become a member of Unifor once you commence employment.  Positions that are of a more permanent nature (permanent part-time, permanent full-time) are awarded based on seniority and qualifications.
Shifting:
Service Representatives are shifted 5 days per week and have various start times. Our Casual Part Time shifts vary in length and are currently between the hours of 8:00-5:00pm Monday - Friday but may evolve based on business needs to include evenings and weekends.
Ideal candidates will be expected to be flexible in their working availability.
There are two types of working shifts. One shift is a scheduled shift where these will be released 30 days prior to the shift.  The other type of shifting is a day-of call-in shift where we would call you in to work the same day.  It is an expectation of SaskTel that you would accept nearly 100% of your scheduled shifts as well as at least 80% of the day-of call-ins.
Training:
Training is typically scheduled for full-time shifts.  Although you will be working various shifts in this position, the training is very structured.  Training will start on your first day of employment and will cover orientation, SaskTel specific systems training as well as technical training.
Passing the training program is a condition of your employment.
You can expect to train between the hours of 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM Monday to Friday based on training requirements.
This is fully paid training, and you must be available to attend 100% of the training.
Why Join Our Talent Pool?
Future Opportunities:
By joining our talent pool, you’ll be on the radar for future job openings that match your skills and experience.
Growth Potential:
SaskTel is committed to providing opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
Innovative Environment
: Work with cutting-edge products and services in a company that values innovation and customer satisfaction.

If you are shortlisted for this position you will be emailed an assessment to assess your typing speed and knowledge of sales. Our assessments are administered through a third party company called ESkills. These assessments take approximately 30-45 minutes to complete. Please complete within 48 hours of receiving.
You may be contacted via email or phone to complete a telephone pre-screen with a member of our staffing team if shortlisted.
An acceptable criminal record check is a condition of employment at SaskTel.
